SBI states its XRP-utilizing remittance service began in 2021; corridor-level volume, current utilization and XRP inventory/turnover are not disclosed in this source.

Circle states both Circle and SBI contributed approximately $1.5M each in November 2025; Circle consolidates the VIE and reported no significant operating results to date as of 2026-06-30. Equal equity ownership does not by itself resolve governance rights.

confirmed_edges.from: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank
confirmed_edges.caveat: SBI Holdings $25M and SBI Shinsei Bank $25M at Circle's June 2025 NYSE IPO.
Registration completed 2025-03-04; public retail handling announced 2025-03-25 for launch 2025-03-26. Actual volumes not provided here.
SBI described RLUSD as a Japanese Type 4 electronic payment instrument. This is stablecoin distribution, not evidence of XRP spot purchases.

confirmed_edges.from: SBI Shinsei Bank and SBI VC Trade
confirmed_edges.caveat: Voucher incentive tied to eligible yen term deposits; not evidence of open-market XRP acquisition or net demand.
SBI did not disclose its subscription amount in the announcement; do not attribute the whole consortium raise to SBI.
Circle reported $324.6M Q2 2026 and $655.3M first-half 2026 distribution costs in connection with agreements with Coinbase. These are accounting expenses, not a disclosed net cash payment amount.
Coinbase allocations depend on USDC held on its platform after issuer retention; Coinbase also receives half of remaining broader ecosystem growth after approved third-party participant payments.
Average $22B in Q3 2026, about 30% of average USDC market cap; includes corporate balances and customer balances in eligible Coinbase products.
Actual XRP collateral utilization, quantity pledged, haircut and net demand remain undisclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail digital-finance strategy, with XRP/Ripple for selected remittance and liquidity use cases and USDC/RLUSD/Circle for dollar settlement and regulated stablecoin distribution.
supporting: SBI publicly describes both SBI Ripple Asia and SBI Circle Holdings in its digital-space ecosystem.
SBI states XRP-utilizing remittance service began in 2021 and SBI VC Trade now distributes both USDC and RLUSD.
disconfirming: Actual corridor-level XRP volumes and stablecoin settlement volumes are not published in the cited sources.
competing_hypotheses.test: Obtain public corridor-level remittance statistics, SBI VC Trade stablecoin volumes, XRPL transaction classifications and partner disclosures.

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC/RLUSD distribution could substitute for XRP as the bridge asset in some corridors, reducing marginal XRP demand if institutions choose stablecoin-to-stablecoin or fiat-to-stablecoin settlement.
supporting: SBI has operational stablecoin distribution through SBI VC Trade; Circle and Ripple stablecoins are available in Japan.
disconfirming: SBI continues to describe XRP-utilizing remittance through SBI Remit; stablecoin distribution does not prove replacement of XRP routes.
competing_hypotheses.test: Compare corridor-level settlement asset shares, XRP bridge legs, stablecoin mint/redeem flows and liquidity-provider inventory over time.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Stablecoins and XRP can be complementary: stablecoins supply dollar-denominated value while XRP provides bridge liquidity, network utility or other asset-transfer functions.
supporting: SBI's own portfolio map lists Circle/USDC and Ripple/XRP businesses in the same digital ecosystem.
Both USDC and RLUSD can exist on XRPL; the assets have distinct roles.
disconfirming: No public route-level evidence yet shows that the same institutional flows use both assets in a single transaction chain.
competing_hypotheses.test: Trace publicly identifiable XRPL payments and issuer/custodian disclosures; separate payment asset from network fee/reserve asset.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's economics and distribution scale strengthen USDC's exchange/custody role and may shift liquidity toward USDC markets, including USDC-quoted XRP derivatives.
supporting: Circle's SEC filing discloses a formulaic distribution arrangement and $324.6M Q2 2026 distribution costs with Coinbase; Coinbase reported $22B average USDC held and ~50% of USDC economics over the past year.
disconfirming: The USDC economics metric is company-reported; it does not demonstrate reduced XRP demand or a direct causal price effect.
competing_hypotheses.test: Track USDC-quoted XRP market depth, exchange collateral usage, stablecoin balances, and XRP spot/perp basis with synchronized time series.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's ARC token presale participation may extend its Circle relationship toward Arc as an alternative stablecoin settlement network.
supporting: SBI disclosed participation through a consolidated subsidiary; Circle's SEC filing records ARC presale-related receivables and deferred revenue.
disconfirming: SBI's allocation amount and any effect on its XRP/Ripple commitments are undisclosed; participation does not prove a shift away from XRPL.
competing_hypotheses.test: Monitor Circle and SBI disclosures for allocation size, Arc validator/settlement commitments, transaction volumes and XRP/XRPL investment changes.

sbic_disambiguation.official_regional_SBIC_entities: Tokyo SBIC East Japan, Osaka SBIC West Japan and Nagoya SBIC Central Japan are separate SME investment/consultation companies under Japan's SME investment law.
sbic_disambiguation.separate_SBI_Circle_JV: SBI Circle Holdings K.K. / Circle SBI Japan K.K. is a distinct 50/50 SBI-Circle joint venture; official SBI material shows both language names for the same JV.
sbic_disambiguation.abbreviation_status: No official source reviewed uses 'SBIC' as the acronym for the SBI-Circle JV. It may be a conversational shorthand or conflation, but this remains unconfirmed.
sbic_disambiguation.chatgpt_connection: Tokyo SBIC East Japan's official 2025 training included ChatGPT usage; this is education, not an OpenAI partnership.

data_quality: SBI's approximately 9% Ripple shareholding is dated June 2025 and must not be presented as a current verified percentage.
SBI's $50M Circle equity investment is separate from the 50/50 JV contribution and from any ARC token presale allocation.
Circle's $324.6M Q2 distribution cost is not the same as a verified cash transfer to Coinbase or Coinbase net revenue.
Coinbase's $22B average USDC held includes $2B corporate balances in Q3 2026; customer balances are therefore not $22B.
Circle's statement of no significant operating results for Circle SBI Japan K.K. is as of June 30, 2026 and does not establish post-period inactivity.
XRP vouchers are an incentive campaign, not a measured spot-market inflow.
ARC token presale proceeds and SBI's subscription amount must be separated; do not attribute Circle's full presale to SBI.
next_actions: Check Circle Q3 2026 results and updated 10-Q after the November 4, 2026 8:00 a.m. ET webcast.
Check SBI's current Ripple shareholding and JV operating status in subsequent filings.
Measure SBI VC Trade USDC/RLUSD circulation and XRP voucher redemption where public data exists.
Reconstruct XRP/USDC/RLUSD liquidity and bridge usage on XRPL by issuer and contract.
Keep all corporate relationships separate from direct XRP token demand unless actual flows are disclosed.
